cli.help:
Rabelus Buddy — a governed AI agent harness.

Usage: rbuddy <command> [options]   (also: rabelus-buddy)

Commands:
  run "<task>"     run a task with the agent (starts the owner if needed)
  resume <run>     resume an interrupted or stopped run
  status           show the owner and the runs
  log <session>    show the events of a session (or of a run)
  providers        show the provider order and which have credentials
  daemon start     start the core owner (sole writer of the log)
  daemon status    show the running owner
  daemon stop      stop the owner
  approvals        list pending approvals
  approve <id>     approve
  deny <id>        deny
  budget           show usage of each budget window
  login <provider> sign in (chatgpt via the browser; the others ask for the key)
  logout <provider> sign out and erase the credential

Options:
  --help           show this help
  --version        show the version
  --no-browser     on login, only print the URL (do not open the browser)
  --lang <lang>    pt-BR or en (default: pt-BR; also via the RBUDDY_LANG variable)
